**Image 1 (Variant B: Index + preview)**
(1) **Yes.** All text is crisp and full-contrast. The dark ink headlines, grey body text, and orange accents are all solid and legible with no transparency or washout.
(2) **No.** There are no clipped, overlapping, or misaligned elements. The layout is clean and the grid alignment is precise.
(3) **Yes.** The topographic map illustration is fully contained within its white plate frame with appropriate padding on all sides.
(4) **Polish: 9/10.** The design is highly professional and perfectly matches the "Field Plot" aesthetic. 
*Remaining concrete defects:* None visible; the only minor observation is that the "Restore a previous session" plate at the top has slightly more vertical whitespace than the main content plates below it, but this appears to be an intentional layout choice rather than a defect.

---

**Image 2 (Variant C: Compact tiles)**
(1) **Yes.** All text is crisp full-contrast. Headlines are dark bold, descriptions are medium-grey, and the annotation footer is light-grey mono—all clearly readable.
(2) **No.** No elements are clipped or overlapping. The 3-column grid is perfectly aligned with consistent gutters and padding within each tile.
(3) **N/A** (This variant contains no illustration plate).
(4) **Polish: 9/10.** Excellent execution of the tile grid system with perfect icon/typography hierarchy.
*Remaining concrete defects:* None. The footer annotation box ("C · COMPACT TILES...") is correctly styled as a dashed-border technical note.

---

**Image 3 (Variant A: Index list)**
(1) **Yes.** Text is crisp and high-contrast throughout. The numbered indices (01–06), bold titles, grey descriptions, and right-arrow icons are all sharply rendered.
(2) **No.** Everything is properly aligned. The single white plate contains six evenly-spaced rows with consistent left-padding for numbers, icons, and text columns.
(3) **N/A** (This variant contains no illustration).
(4) **Polish: 9/10.** Clean, scannable list layout that effectively uses the numbered rows and chevron indicators.
*Remaining concrete defects:* None. The bottom annotation correctly identifies this as "INDEX LIST" with the dashed border styling.
